policy_action: Elimination of administrative multi-tier exchange rates and unification into autonomous NAFEM window; clearance of $7B legacy forward backlog

alternative_drivers: Structural elimination of currency subsidies; short-term price shock transitioned into medium-term reserve rebuilding

related_indicator: FAAC Distributable Revenue (₦786B to ₦3.007T); Fiscal Deficit-to-GDP reduction; NNPC dividend remittances to federation account

reform_name: National Tax Harmonization & Fiscal Policy Reform
policy_action: Enactment of Nigeria Tax Act 2025; reduction of company income tax burdens on micro-enterprises; restructuring VAT derivation formula (States 55% FGN 10%)
transmission_mechanism: Consolidation of over 60 disparate taxes into unified single-digit tax heads -> reduced compliance friction -> enhanced non-oil tax collection efficiency through automated FIRS/NBS platforms
related_indicator: Non-oil Real GDP contribution (96.08%); FAAC VAT disbursements (State allocations exceeded ₦1T monthly aggregate)
causal_evidence_strength: Subnational revenue absorption efficiency varies widely; states require continued structural reforms to convert allocations into capital investments
alternative_drivers: Documented surge in Companies Income Tax (CIT) and VAT receipts reported by FIRS and OAGF without raising baseline headline tax rates

reform_name: Orthodox Central Bank Tightening & Inflation Targeting
policy_action: Hiked Monetary Policy Rate by cumulative +900 bps (18.50% to 27.50% peak before easing to 26.50%); raised CRR to 45.00%; introduced open market stabilization bills
transmission_mechanism: Aggressive interest rate hikes -> increased real yields on domestic debt instruments -> contracted excess money supply (M2 growth deceleration) -> anchored core inflation expectations
related_indicator: Core CPI Inflation (moderated to 14.97%); M2 Money Supply Growth; Inflow of foreign fixed-income portfolio capital
causal_evidence_strength: Food inflation remains elevated (20.31%) due to structural supply-side factors (insecurity transport costs climate shocks) which monetary policy cannot directly solve
alternative_drivers: Narrowing gap between headline inflation and policy rate; stabilization of core price indices

reform_name: Upstream Maritime Security & Petroleum Sector Revitalization
